messages:
alexa: deploy-bot just cut rollout v3.8.4 to 40% for /embeddings, p95 +47% vs baseline. looks like quant change. options: quick route-split, manual rollback, or pin-to-stable for impacted tenants. who's available to make the call?

deploy-bot: [automated] Rollout throttled to 40%. Trigger: embeddings_p95_delta >= 45% (5m). Suggested actions: wait 10m; split traffic to v3.7.9; manual rollback to v3.7.9.

ops-oncall: i'm here. prefer scoped split first to reduce blast. if no steady improvement in 12m -> manual rollback. also recommend disabling autorevert (manual gate).

marc: i can enact an 80/20 split (v3.8.4/v3.7.9) in ~4m and prep the rollback CLI snippet. will also pre-stage pin commands for large tenants.

kai: i'll draft a short internal blurb for #customers in case we escalate. keep it neutral: "temporary performance regression noted; mitigation in progress; we'll follow up."

alexa: marc do the split and prep pin. ops, if you call rollback, use this command: ```/deploy rollback --service=embeddings --to=v3.7.9 --reason="latency regression after quant update"```

deploy-bot: [system] Autorevert suppressed by operator request. Autorevert paused until 4387658000.

marc: split applied: 80% -> v3.8.4, 20% -> v3.7.9. sanity checks: no 5xx, logs for fallback look normal.

ops-oncall: t+6m update: p95 down from +47% -> +31%. trend improving but still above alert. hold to t+12m. if p95 > +25% then execute rollback.

kai: drafting customer note and short FAQ for support. will post if rollback is executed.

alexa: note for docs: if we rollback, we should pin v3.7.9 for affected customers and add a release-note line about the quant kernel perf regression.

ops-oncall: copy. plan: if stable < +20% for 30m, ramp back to 100% gradually. if not, rollback and pin. reconvene at t+12m. :thumbsup:
